description.content: Delete existing entities. Using the :http:method:`delete` on a project's endpoint will *completely delete* an entity. The Gen3 commons does not allow deletions or creations that would leave nodes without parents, i.e. nodes that do not have an entity from which they were derived. To prevent catastrophic mistakes, the current philosophy is to disallow automatic cascading of deletes. However, to inform a user which entities must be deleted for the target entity to be deleted, the API will respond with at least one entity that must be deleted prior to deleting the target entity.

query.description: Set the to_delete sysan as true or false. If none, then don't try to set the sysan, and instead delete the node.
